hookups.source: rec.gov notice ('No RV hookups are available. No dumping waste water.') + per-site catalog (all 32 STANDARD/TENT NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 29 RV/trailer sites and 3 tent-only (18-20), gravel spurs, 5 pull-throughs (8, 21, 23, 26, 28). Most RV sites sit within about 80 m of the lake, sites 9-12 and 32 within 30 m. The catalog gives no vehicle lengths; FS states a 45-ft RV maximum.

sites.source: FS page ('This facility has 32 sites'; 'Maximum RV length is 45 feet') + rec.gov catalog (types, Driveway Entry, Driveway Surface Gravel, per-site coordinates vs the OSM Lake O'Haver outline), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Water, trash and the host may not be available early and late in the season. Firewood sold at the host site ($10 a bundle).

facilities.source: FS page (Restrooms 'vault toilet'; 'Potable water is available at this site'; 'Services such as water, trash or a host may not be available during early and late season'; 'Firewood is available for sale at the host site for $10 per bundle'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: FS: open May to October, dates weather dependent. In 2026 rec.gov ran walk-up only May 8-21 and September 22-October 11 either side of the reservation season.

season.source: FS page (Seasons of Use: 'May to October. Opening and closing dates are weather dependent') + rec.gov rates (2026 'First-come, First-served Season' 2026-05-08 to 05-21 and 2026-09-22 to 10-11), read 2026-10-27. The derived close of 09-21 was the end of the reservation season, not of the campground's.

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov or 877-444-6777 at least four days ahead. Sites 1-5, 7, 13, 21, 23 and 24 are always first-come, and site 6 too once the host leaves after September; every site is walk-up outside the reservation season. Walk-ups are exempt from the weekend and holiday minimums and must be occupied the night paid for. Usually full from Friday (sometimes Thursday); no phone service at the campground.

booking.source: FS page ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum') + rec.gov description ('Sites #1-5, 7 ,13,21,23 and 24 are first-come, first-served ... Site #6 is used by the host from mid-May through September') + rules (minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4) + rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-21), read 2026-10-27

values.note: $28 a site (2026, the same in 2027-28); double sites 11 and 12 $56. Two vehicles or one RV included, $10 for a third vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231870/rates (2026 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 28, double STANDARD NONELECTRIC 56, TENT ONLY 28) + FS page ('$28 fee per site for overnight camping ... $10 fee for a third vehicle'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 50% for Senior and Access pass holders, on the site the pass holder occupies; not on double sites 11 and 12.

discounts.source: FS page ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites') + rec.gov notice ('Double sites are not eligible for Senior or Access Pass discounts, this includes sites 11 and 12'), read 2026-10-27

note: Salida Ranger District campground (Pike-San Isabel NF) on the shore of O'Haver Lake at 9,200 ft, 2.5 miles up County Road 202 off Marshall Pass Road (CR 200) southwest of Poncha Springs. Non-motorized boats only; accessible fishing pier. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov description/rules/rates/catalog: confirmed 32 sites, no hookups, $28 (2026), reservable with walk-up sites. Changed max rig 85 -> 45 ft (FS stated maximum; catalog gives no lengths). Cleared the derived season close 09-21 (that is the end of the reservation season; FS says May to October, walk-up to Oct 11 in 2026) and recorded year_round false. Added pull-throughs, vault toilets, potable water, fcfs some_sites, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night max, booking season 05-22 to 09-21, Senior/Access discount. flags: Phone missing: the FS page gives the Salida Ranger District, 719-539-3591 (5575 Cleora Road, Salida); rec.gov also lists (661) 702-1420 for facility-specific information. The stored note had the wrong district (South Platte RD); Ohaver Lake is on the Salida Ranger District.
Website is the recreation.gov listing; the FS campground page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/ohaver-lake-campground.

Pin checked: 124 m from the centroid of the 29 RV-site coordinates (FS gives 38.42596,-106.14361). Lakefront supported: most RV sites are within ~80 m of the OSM lake outline, five within 30 m.
Closed now for the season (FS: May to October; 2026 walk-up season ended Oct 11). Salida RD fire danger 'High' on the FS page; no closure order found for this campground.
